description: This file defines the Country entity class used in the sales management system, including its properties, JPA annotations for ORM mapping, and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: Entity class representing a country with related data such as ISO code, supported status, geographic zone, and descriptions.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the country (transient property).

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the country (transient property).

methods.name: Country
methods.description: Default constructor for creating a Country instance.

methods.name: Country
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the country with its ISO code.

methods.name: getSupported
methods.description: Returns whether the country is supported.

methods.name: setSupported
methods.description: Sets the supported status of the country.

methods.name: getIsoCode
methods.description: Returns the ISO code of the country.

methods.name: setIsoCode
methods.description: Sets the ISO code of the country.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the country (overrides method from superclass).

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the country (overrides method from superclass).

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Returns the list of zones associated with the country.

methods.name: setZones
methods.description: Sets the list of zones associated with the country.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of descriptions for the country.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of descriptions for the country.

methods.name: getGeoZone
methods.description: Returns the geographic zone associated with the country.

methods.name: setGeoZone
methods.description: Sets the geographic zone associated with the country.
